subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-page Group by channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main partially covers channel organization, but a true merged timeline changes transcript aggregation, privacy, routing, and UI semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Timeline Semantics
options.body: Keep this as the canonical channel-view thread and define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before any implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close this issue if maintainers decide the Group by channel table plus per-session chat navigation is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining timeline work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace design to own it.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Timeline Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this as the canonical channel-view thread and define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before any implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main implementation and docs update for channel grouping came through steipete's recent Control UI session grouping work.
